issue_context.title: Make the "GetResourceRequest" logic in scheduler pkg more clean
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**> This issue is for tracking some problems I found and I plan to fix.**

**Why is this needed**:
During I fixed the bug [**bugfix: initcontainer is also taken into account when calculating resource requests**](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/89222), I found some issues of calculating resource request logic existed in scheduler package.  

1. **Duplication**: Actually, in Kubernetes code base, only kube-scheduler gives the default resource request to every container for calculating score purpose. So we have our own logic. But there is a [unified function](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/5713c22eecff4610026643fbd3d37c33a43c168d/pkg/api/v1/resource/helpers.go#L133) which also can be used to get the resource request of pod  in `/pkg/api/v1/resource` package. 

2. **Default resource request value**: In the [current implementation](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/noderesources/resource_allocation.go#L118), we check every container of one pod if it specifies the explicit resource request. If there is no explicit value, we will give a default resource request value to the **container**. Actually, we can change the default value of per container to per pod. It likes 
```go
resourceRequest := max(sum(pod.Spec.Containers), max(pod.Spec.InitContainers))
if  resourceRequest== 0 {
              resourceRequest = defaultResourceRequestValue
}
```
3. **Explicit zero resource request**:  In this [unit test](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/3538320d74f98fc0972206d20cd3d76186d88aa9/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/noderesources/least_allocated_test.go#L100), it specifies the explicit zero resource request. It looks like this test doesn't want to get the default resource request. It should be considered carefully ****If we should give the default resource request value** for the pod which specifies the explicit zero value**. [Context](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/89222#discussion_r411617331)

4. **IsScalarResourceName**: In our [current of calculating non zero resource request logic](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/b850b5ce2e7d282abae01a26be4d14d56d71bfad/pkg/scheduler/util/non_zero.go#L76), we consider if the resource belongs to the **scalar resource**. Not sure if it is valuable to remain. Because the [GetResourceRequest](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/5713c22eecff4610026643fbd3d37c33a43c168d/pkg/api/v1/resource/helpers.go#L133) of `/pkg/api/v1/resource` package doesn't consider it.

5. **Lack of correct test cases**: When I fixing the bug I mentioned, I found it is hard to add the test logic about initContainer in [TestNodeInfoRemovePod](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/framework/v1alpha1/types_test.go#L814). Because it uses the [MakeBasePod](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/3e2ae631b4caef5f823a5e121f860c653da32ff5/pkg/scheduler/framework/v1alpha1/types_test.go#L247) to construct the pod test cases. The current logic of  [MakeBasePod](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/3e2ae631b4caef5f823a5e121f860c653da32ff5/pkg/scheduler/framework/v1alpha1/types_test.go#L247) is not good for me. We should refactor it and make the test for "GetResourceRequest" logic more complete.

In my [bugfix PR](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/89222), for easier to cherry-pick to the older version, I just focus on fixing the bug based on the current implementation.  So I think we need to do the improvement in following PRs.

The overall idea sounds good to me and I think we can discuss some details in a PR.

Non-zero values are used to calculate scores (not to perform filters). A couple of thoughts:

1. We have some slack in changing those calculations and I'm ok with making the values per-pod. The effect will be that some nodes that used to get a zero score now get a small value.
1. Since the code is not used anywhere else, we can have this code in the noderesources  (instead of utils package), with an appropriate comment mentioning the difference from the shared calculations.

The calculations without non-zero defaults can and should be shared across k8s code.

> IsScalarResourceName: In our current of calculating non zero resource request logic, we consider if the resource belongs to the scalar resource. Not sure if it is valuable to remain. Because the GetResourceRequest of /pkg/api/v1/resource package doesn't consider it.

This question requires discussion with sig-node folks and dig in the history of the implementation of IsScalarResourceName to understand the initial motivation for it.

We could start unifying just the scheduler code in `pkg/scheduler/utils` or `pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/helper` to initiate sig-scheduling discussions.

And we could leave the changes that affect kubelet for a followup PR.

How about we have the code in frameworkv1alpha1/types.go instead of noderesources since it will be used by nodeinfo?

Perhaps we can have a single function in types.go that calculates the total pod resources, and the function accepts a ```WithNonZero()```:

```GetPodResources(pod *v1.Pod, options ...PodResourcesOption) (requests *v1.ResourceList, limits *v1.ResourceList)```

The limits will be used by ```ResourceLimits``` plugin.

> How about we have the code in frameworkv1alpha1/types.go instead of noderesources since it will be used by nodeinfo?

Then that code wouldn't be shared with kubelet.

How would nodeinfo be able to calculate pod resources if the function is placed in noderesources?

> Then that code wouldn't be shared with kubelet.

Why not? They do have a dependency on nodeinfo I think, and so the dependency on the framework isn't new.

> How would nodeinfo be able to calculate pod resources if the function is placed in noderesources?

>> Then that code wouldn't be shared with kubelet.

> Why not? They do have a dependency on nodeinfo I think, and so the dependency on the framework isn't new.

ok, I think we can do better by unifying all uses under a single function with an option for non-zero.

2. Change the "assign default resource request logic" from per container to per pod
